comment: What a disorganized professor with little to no experience. The class was awful and the professor seemed to know nothing but cliches from books she read.

Seems like a sweet lady however I truly struggled in her class. She is incredibly disorganized and very unclear with her expectations. I felt as though I never knew what she was looking for and her grading was incredibly strict. Rubric expectations are different than what the prompts say.

She said on the first day of class that she was disorganized... could not have predicted how detrimental it would be to the overall class experience. The sweetest person, but super nit-picky with papers and SO DISORGANIZED to the point where I had added stress about due dates and the syllabus constantly changing. It was a nightmare!
She is a really nice person and very accessible/understandable. However, her class is difficult and she is very politically biased. This shows through her curriculum and teaching.

dr. koetsen is so passionate about her content and really cares about her students. She gives such detailed feedback, always gives you the ability to correct mistakes on past papers and tests and gives so many options for extra credit. There's a good amount of work but its all very doable. in Justice you learn about social issues though philosophy

Dr. Coetsee is fantastic. She is open and accepting for all points of view and is willing to meet students for whatever accommodations they may need, including last minute extensions. Though she assigns a decent amount of work, her expectations are always clear. I guarantee you will learn lots if you take her class.
